Pikadūta
in 31 Śārdūlavikrīḍita verses. Gopīs sending Cuckoo a. messenger to Kṛṣṇa.
Ms. with Chintaharan Cakravarti. See IHQ. III. p. 278, no. 21, fn. 4; also Jaina Sid. Bhās. II. ii. p. 61.
--by Rudranātha Pañcānana. Dacca 416E (inc.).

Pikanikara
poet. pseudonym ?
Skm. p. 125 (Lahore edn.). verse 904 (Calcutta edn.). [Page081-a.

Pikaprativacana
modern. by Jagannāthaśāstrin.
Pt.. Hitacintaka Press. Benares (1923). See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1915.

Pikasandeśa
by Dādhīca, Brahmadeva Colaṅkhyā Śarmā. modern; description of the then fallen condition of India by a Cuckoo to a poet. See IHQ. III. p. 286.
Pt.. Jhalrapatan. Benares, 1923. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 176.
